global_options.description: List of global syslogd options (e.g., 'log_fifo_uid', 'log_procuid') — passed directly to syslogd as command-line-style options.

items.description: A single syslogd global option flag.

rules.description: List of logging rules. Each rule specifies which messages to log, and where to send them.

priority.description: Priority level (e.g., 'info', 'err', 'debug', '*=warn' for all priorities ≥ warn, 'none' to disable, etc.).

target.description: Target for the log message: file path (e.g., '/var/log/syslog'), device (e.g., '/dev/console'), user (e.g., 'root'), or special (e.g., '+host', '|cmd').
